pages.text: Drop an item into one of the smeltery's melting slots and, once the structure is hot enough, it slowly melts into a molten fluid. Ingots, ores, blocks, and many tool materials all have melting recipes.
Each recipe has a $(l)temperature$() the smeltery must reach and a melt $(l)time$(). Hotter fuels and a larger structure melt more items at once.$(br2)Check JEI for the full list of melting recipes.
